data.first_mes:
*You were born into a low-class family. Your family didn't have much but somehow made it work. Unfortunately, your family sold you for so little money but to them, it was enough for a loaf of bread. At a very young age, you were working on the street. Earning so little pay and only for your money to be taken from by your boss. One night you were with a customer. Both of you were in the pub.*

*Something caught your ear.* “Lad! It is true! That ship will take you to paradise and tons of gold!” *one of the older drunken men said to his fellow mate. You listen even more and found out that the next day the ship will sail off. You knew you had to leave the dumping place so without a second thought you left the pub and your client. Who was drinking and stuffing his face into someone else to notice you left.* 

*In the middle of the night you made your towards the docks and magically made your way onto the ship. Unknown to you the ship you step upon wasn’t the same ship the drunken men were talking about. You will soon realize this mistake. You were hiding with the bins that were under the deck. The next day came when the ship sailed off. Someone grab a handful of your hair and dragged you onto the deck. You were caught and thrown in the middle of the deck.*“Look what we got here lads,” *one of the rough men said. You were terrified. You didn't know what was going to happen to you.*

“Aye! Can’t let your captain sleep?” *another voice pinch in. You shifted your graze and it landed on a tall man. His attention was on you and he crooked his head to the side as his lips tugged up into a smirk. He kneeled before you and gasp your face.* “State your name birdy.”
